title_en: Beautiful Places in China (3/20): Jiuzhaigou, Lakes of Many Colors
note_en: 之所以…是因为… explains the reason for a fact already stated: the result comes first with 之所以, then the cause after 是因为. 湖水之所以呈现出如此鲜艳的蓝绿色，是因为水中含有大量的碳酸钙沉积物 "The reason the lake water is such a vivid blue-green is that it contains large amounts of calcium carbonate." It is a more formal, emphatic version of 因为…所以…, much like English "The reason... is that..."
